verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.databricks.com/llms.txt. Its header is titled "Databricks Documentation" and describes comprehensive platform docs, so an agent can be pointed at an official llms.txt index. Only the header was captured, so the file's coverage and structure are unverified, and the pack shows no other agent-oriented doc formats. Missing for 10: verified depth and coverage of the llms.txt contents, an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and first-party documentation or independent corroboration of the agent-oriented docs offering.
